about: Party stands (assist dead band): a 6-mob Shattered Halls pack with three Sharpshooters pulled by LOS-break around a corner (snapshot tr-20260922-192712-28#6, a real LOS pull). The camp-assist trigger stood down on a bare 28.5yd GetRange("spell") test while the action and stock reach spell use spellRange + combat reach (~31.7yd), so a ranged follower parked in that band was driven by nobody (issue #18 reporter trace: both casters pinned at 29-31yd). Fixed on master by 3d85fa94 (same patch as the unmerged fix/assist-trigger-range-deadband b7cc196d). The party starts 15yd up the corridor from the real tank spot.
